sources: US Department of Homeland Security (Federal Register notice, Oct 28) via Reuters; IANS summary of the three-front week
fault_line: Forced-labour enforcement or tech-war escalation: does blacklisting BGI protect rights, or just widen the US-China split?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT] The US Department of Homeland Security added BGI Genomics, MGI Tech and Shenzhen BGI Technology (collectively BGI Group) to the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act Entity List, effective October 29: US Customs applies a rebuttable presumption that their goods are prohibited from entering the US. DHS said it has 'reasonable cause to believe' BGI Genomics conducts genetic testing in Xinjiang with the regional government in initiatives that facilitate forced labour. Separately, a DHS notice published Oct 27 suspends the Northern Mariana Islands EVS-TAP visa-free programme for pre-screened Chinese nationals effective Oct 30, citing espionage risks near Tinian/Guam facilities, smuggling and birth tourism (3,000+ users in FY2025); the Pentagon designated Confucius Institutes at 30 universities a national security threat. BGI Genomics says its US business is limited and it does not expect a significant impact (via Aju Press). Assessed NOT a major country-level sanctions change for elevation purposes: it is a targeted entity listing + travel-programme suspension, not a new country sanctions regime; no elevation trigger fired. Content is monitor-only under the proven-topics lock (US-China sanctions are not in the proven set; zero hits in the fresh social sample).
sections.what_verified: 2 declared families: Reuters T1 (listing) + DHS T1 STATE (US) as the acting authority (Federal Register notice). IANS/mid-day/nationalherald are undeclared carriers and do not add to the count.
sections.what_disputed: Beijing's response not retrieved this hour; the forced-labour allegation itself is a US government determination ('reasonable cause to believe'), not an adjudicated finding -- report as a US determination, not as proven fact about BGI's operations.
sections.why_matters: None -- monitor only; no production angle until a Chinese retaliation or a market/supply impact lands.
